title: Tokenized Opportunity Buckets for Roadmap Slicing
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Introduce a pragmatic prioritization framework — Tokenized Opportunity Buckets (TOB) — that augments RICE with workload token economics and latency-regime risk. TOB is designed to help PMs slice roadmap candidates into discrete opportunity buckets that align to capacity regimes (hosted, dedicated, private) and OKRs while making cost/latency trade-offs explicit for engineering and finance conversations.
problem_statement: Current RICE-centric prioritization lacks granularity for token-economics and latency-risk across deployment regimes. This leads to misaligned investments (e.g., platform features that shift cost-to-usage without clear throughput/latency ROI). We need a framework that maps feature outcomes to token costs, latency sensitivity, and capacity regimes so we can prioritize initiatives that move key OKRs cost-effectively.
proposal_summary: TOB complements RICE by converting expected impact into 'token opportunity' units and applying a latency-regime penalty curve. The core output is a bucketed score that surfaces high-return, low-latency-risk initiatives and highlights those requiring Dedicated/Private investments. Deliverables: scoring spreadsheet, dashboard slice in Console, prioritization playbook for PMs and ENG leads, and a demo prioritization run for Q2 roadmap.
scoring_formula: BaseScore = R * I * (ReachFactor) / Effort; TokenizedOpportunity = BaseScore * ExpectedTokensPerUnit; LatencyRiskMultiplier = 1 - exp(-alpha * p95_latency_sensitivity); TOBScore = TokenizedOpportunity * LatencyRiskMultiplier / CostPerTokenAdjusted
acceptance_criteria: 1) Spreadsheet prototype that scores 25 candidate initiatives and produces bucket assignments; 2) Console mock showing per-initiative token-opportunity and latency-risk visualization; 3) PM playbook published in Confluence with step-by-step scoring and decision thresholds; 4) Stakeholder sign-off from Eng-Infra and Finance on assumptions and CostPerTokenAdjusted model.
expected_impact: Reduce mis-prioritization incidents by surfacing cost-latency regressions earlier; expected 15-25% improvement in token-econ ROI for top-10 roadmap items per quarter; clearer signal for when to propose Dedicated capacity investments.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy token estimates. Mitigation: use conservative ranges and attach sensitivity bands; run two-pass scoring (optimistic/pessimistic) and mark high-variance items for follow-up research. Risk: stakeholder pushback on weighting. Mitigation: run calibration workshop with Eng leads and Finance and persist weights as versioned parameters.
rollout_plan: Week 1: finalize scoring spreadsheet and assumptions; Week 2: internal calibration workshop with Eng and Finance; Week 3: prototype Console visualization and publish playbook; Week 4: apply TOB to Q2 candidate list and present to GTM+Exec for roadmap decision.
metrics_to_track: Adoption: number of PMs using TOB for roadmapping; Precision: % of high-TOB items that meet 50%+ of projected token ROI in next quarter; Signal: reduction in post-release latency regressions tied to prioritized initiatives.
